$comment: V-80 and A15. Transferred kilobytes for a cold load at 390x844, per route, and the landing's height. A null budget is reported and never fails: run `node scripts/check-weight.mjs --record` against a PRODUCTION build (the CI speed job prints the measured weights) and each budget becomes the measured weight minus 20 percent. Ratchet down, never up without a reason in the commit. /wallet was retired on 25 September and is gone from the list. Heights are a ratchet too: the UIUX item 9 targets are under 8,000px at 390 and under 6,500px at 1440, and the landing is above both (A7 and A8 added the check room and the move-in card on 30 September), so the budget holds today's height and must only come down.
